semanticAmendments.boundary: DialogContent bodyPadding only; the existing convention meaning and other component usages remain unchanged.

convention.name: overlayScope
convention.meaning: The layout boundary of a Dialog modal overlay grid.
convention.whenToUse: Choose viewport or container layout for the Dialog overlay, independently of the portal mount target.
convention.avoid: Portal mount targets, generic positioning, collision boundaries or claims of locally scoped modality.

convention.name: padding
convention.meaning: Preset inner spacing between a container's edge and its content, mapped to spacing tokens.
convention.whenToUse: A container primitive such as Surface offers a few token-backed padding presets, including none for edge-to-edge content.
convention.avoid: Gaps between children (use gap), outer margins, arbitrary lengths or per-side overrides.

exceptions.reason: Only the body changes; padding would misleadingly describe the whole panel
